title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a process used to convert categorical data into a numerical format that can be used in machine learning models. Each category is represented by a binary vector.

title: Column Rank in One-Hot Encoding
text: The column rank of a one-hot encoded dataset is equal to the number of unique categories in the original categorical variable.
